entities.note: t10 holds this group (brief). Members owned by t11 (by what and where, for the merge to add): the man with his back to the viewer handing something to the next man (foot about (28162, 791), head (28153, 658)); the man in a hat receiving from him (head about (28220, 646)); the man holding a tally stick upright (u about 28245-28290, v 610-785); the young man bending over the heap with a dark pouch or tally (head (28211, 773), feet hidden at about (28215, 900)); the porter with a sack on his shoulder (u about 28230-28300, v 805-960); the porter with a big sack on his back walking east (u about 28300-28380, v 800-940); the porter carrying a sack up the bank (about 28230-28390, v 1100-1230); sacks at u 28200-28240 (v 893-933). river_e's: the grain boat with the gangplank (its plank lands at about (28023, 1050)) and anyone on the plank (nobody is on it on the scan between u 27800 and 28030). Merge: t11's members joined (they carried the placeholder group S2.grp.grain_porters): the young man bending over the heap S2.fig.youth_topknot_28222 (t10: head (28211, 773)), the porter with a sack on his shoulder S2.fig.sack_porter_back_28271, the porter walking east S2.fig.sack_porter_28343, a fourth porter bent under a sack further east S2.fig.sack_porter_bent_28432 (t11 only) and the porter climbing the bank S2.fig.bank_porter_28355 (from the second grain boat). t11's part of the heap was the same sacks as S2.prop.sack_heap_28144 (retired). The three men handing over tallies or clasping hands (t10's "tally men": S2.fig.handshake_youth_28163, S2.fig.bowing_man_28270, S2.fig.staff_man_28266) keep their own group S2.grp.handshake_28220, a vignette inside this scene.

entities.name: seller at his tub
entities.what: A seller sitting by his big tub under the upper shed's eave, holding out a bowl.

entities.name: man raising the pennant frame
entities.what: A man at the lower shed's east end holding up the lower end of one of the two leaning poles that carry a cord of small pennants.
entities.note: The frame leans on the lower shed (structures_e's building).

entities.name: the grain boat's mooring on the bank
entities.what: The bank end of the west grain boat's mooring: a stake with a rope coil at its foot, from which two lines run down to the boat.
entities.note: The lines and the boat (the grain boat with the gangplank, about u 27270-28100) are river_e's; the lines' far end is this coil and stake.
